name: Image Operations
description: Masks, resampling, crop, quarter turns and rotation by any angle with the straighten crop, blur, tone adjustments and histograms (levels, curves and histograms on linear or sRGB-encoded values) and cloning from an offset through a mask over PixelBuffer. W1/ declares the values the W1 engines share (AffineMatrix, ColorLUT, LayerEffect and the tone, matte, fill and gradient values), with no operations. Masks/ holds mask feathering, contours and mattes read from a buffer. Tone/ holds the color-family tone ops and the auto-tone suggestion. Effects/ holds the layer effects a PixelBuffer applies, and layer styles: LayerStyleStack (style entries, each with its own blend mode, opacity and switch, and the fill opacity), beveled (bevel and emboss height from the alpha distance field in four shapes and three techniques, lit by angle and altitude into highlight and shadow layers) and styled, which draws every enabled entry in a fixed paint order (drop shadow, outer glow and outside stroke under the layer and knocked out by it; the layer at its fill opacity; overlays, inner glow, inner shadow, the bevel and inside strokes clipped over it), the result the buffer's size, with reach the padding a caller adds so nothing clips. Affine/ holds transforms through an AffineMatrix, flips and canvas padding. Fill/ holds flood fill by tolerance, colour range masks and raster gradient fills, with FillColor, the one colour distance flood fill and colour range share (Euclidean OKLab of the straight colours, alpha as a fourth axis). Heal/ holds the gradient-domain heal from an offset through a mask, seeded fill from surroundings (a patch search followed by a heal), dodge, burn and sponge tone dabs by TonalRange, and the SmudgeState brush state. Hash/ holds PerceptualHash, a 64-bit DCT hash of a buffer: resampled to 32 x 32 with the bilinear filter (which averages areas when shrinking), Rec. 709 luminance of the premultiplied values, so alpha composites over black, sRGB-encoded, a 2-D DCT-II, and one bit per coefficient (u, v) in 1...8 (the DC row and column dropped) set when it is above their median; distance is the popcount of the XOR, and the same buffer gives the same bits on every platform. It also holds DuplicateGroups, which puts ids whose hashes chain within a distance (clamped to 0...10, negative groups nothing, since past 10 random hashes start to chain) into groups of two or more, each id in one group, each group sorted by id and the list by first id, through a multi-index table over four 16-bit blocks and a union-find, near-linear in the number of hashes.
